title: Tenma Saki — See You At The Thank You Show!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: See You At The Thank You Show!（2★）

rows.Line: Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: I'm back!

rows.Speaker: Mother's Voice
rows.Line: Welcome home, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line:
You're back sooner than expected.
I thought you were all going to throw an after-party or something...

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: We're gonna make our own snacks and stuff, so we're having it on a later date♪

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: More importantly, did you look outside?! It's absolutely incredible...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Incredible...? Oh, the meteor shower!

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: Yeah♪ Mom, Tsukasa, you gotta check it out! Come here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Okay, we're coming.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
This breeze feels so nice...
And there aren't that many clouds out tonight.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, what a beautiful night sky.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: See what I mean?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Look! Over there!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, a shooting star!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mom, did you see it?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yes, I saw it.
Oh, there's another one.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Two in such quick succession!
I can't imagine what this is going to be like at its peak!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me neither! And now that our show's done, I can enjoy it to the fullest!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: That's wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: At the same time, Saki, I'm so sorry... I wish I could've gone to your show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, that's totally okay!
Work is work, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're gonna do lots and lots of shows as pros moving forward, and you guys will always be welcome to come see us perform!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know I've caused you a lot of stress, so I'll make up for all that by putting on a really amazing performance♪

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Then, when you do...
I promise to be there with your father!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My little sister... She loves her parents so much!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki, as your brother, I could not be more proud...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, Tsukasa, why are you the one who's tearing up?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. Your father was asking about your show, Saki. Please be sure to tell him how it went.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I will!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But he's probably still at work, huh?
I'll send him a message for now♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
“Our show was a huge success♪
I got home just now. I'm watching the meteor shower with Mom and Tsukasa!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki, why don't you also send him a picture?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa, great idea!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Then, we'll have the stars in the back...
Mom, Tsukasa, come closer!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. Are we all in?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
I'll send it to him now♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. Sounds like someone's worked up an appetite.
I'll get back to making dinner now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, that's right. We're having curry tonight!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
C-Curry?!
Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Dad just replied!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Oh, what did he say?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
<Congratulations on a successful show!
I also just saw a bit of the meteor shower with my coworkers!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, he added a picture!
Check it out!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, he used the sky as the background too! Nice one, Dad!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
He is still at work, right...?
Also, what's with this silly pose?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
This is Dad we're talking about...
It must mean something!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm...
He has his arm by his waist, but he appears to be holding something while trying to raise it in the air.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: He's also holding something else with his other hand.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hmm...
This pose looks really familiar for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, he's pretending to be Perseus...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Just look at this illustration of his constellation! Aren't they identical?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not only did he reply, he took this fun picture for us. As we should expect from Dad!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
And he had someone at work take it for him...
Hehe. What are we going to do with him?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha! The person who took it must've been cracking up♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh... I think my stomach wants to be heard now...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, dear...
I should finish making dinner before it decides to do anything rash.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll help you, Mom.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, me too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Aren't you tired from your show?
I should be more than enough...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I wanna help.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: I appreciate it. Then, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Saki & Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Of course!
